features: Wireless & Powerful Sound : Experience rich, room-filling sound with this wireless 10W HD soundbar. Fill your room with powerful sound and elevate your movie and music experiences.
Effortless Streaming : Enjoy wireless freedom and effortless connection with Decibel 24. Stream music, podcasts, or audiobooks with a reliable connection of Bluetooth 5.3.
Play It Your Way : Choose your music source with this portable bluetooth speaker. This versatile wireless soundbar lets you choose your preferred connection: Bluetooth, AUX, TF card, USB flash drive
Amplify Your Audio TWS Surround Sound: Connect two of these wireless soundbars for an immersive TWS surround sound experience and to create a captivating movie theater atmosphere.

5 Hours of Non-Stop Entertainment:: Keep the party going with this wireless soundbar. The convenient Type-C charging port allows for quick recharges, ensuring uninterrupted music, podcasts, or movies on the go.

Splashproof Entertainment: Bring the party poolside with confidence! This IPX4 water-resistant bluetooth soundbar shrugs off splashes and spills, making it the perfect companion for worry-free outdoor entertainment.
description: Immerse yourself in wireless and powerful sound with the Decibel 24 soundbar, boasting a rich 10W HD audio that fills your room with captivating sound. Enjoy effortless streaming via Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, allowing you to seamlessly play music, podcasts, or audiobooks from any compatible device. With versatile connectivity options including Bluetooth, AUX, TF card, and USB flash drive, you can play your music your way. Elevate your audio experience with TWS surround sound by connecting two soundbars for immersive theater-like sound. Plus, with 5 hours of non-stop entertainment and a convenient Type-C charging port, the party never has to stop. Take the fun outdoors worry-free with its IPX4 water-resistant design, perfect for poolside or beachside entertainment. Whether at home or on the go, the Decibel 24 soundbar ensures a truly immersive and convenient audio experience
